known_limitations: The search is systematic and citation-chained but is not a registered systematic review.
Absence of an exact match cannot support first, unique, or unprecedented wording.
Several included arXiv primary pages may later receive proceedings versions and require refresh.

The repository validate_related_work.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; producer used deterministic CSV/YAML/cross-file checks, and independent reviewer must decide whether a dedicated semantic validator is required.
Search saturation is provisional and requires refresh before final claim freeze and submission.
unexpected_findings: Recent ACL 2026 work trains Qwen2.5-3B to use Prolog and reports an accuracy-auditability tradeoff; this occupies any broad small-model-plus-Prolog claim but strengthens the fixed-weight interface-placement distinction.
Grammar-constrained logical parsing is a particularly strong matched control because it can improve small-model parsing without executing an authoritative conclusion.
No reviewed source combined all seven defining dimensions in one causal experiment, but this finding authorizes only the positive narrow comparison, not a priority claim.
